thread:
Leah (CS): Heads-up — CardWave just sent their vendor questionnaire + DPA follow-ups. Need quick triage: they asked about embeddings retention, SOC2 scope for non-prod, and a subprocessor appendix. Deadline EOD Wed. PDFs attached to the ticket: https://rwd/internal/tickets/CH-4598 :spiral_calendar:
Sam (Eng): I can take the infra/serving questions. Which envs did they list as 'non-prod'?
Leah (CS): They listed staging + a 'preprod' cluster. They're worried about backups and whether those environments are in our SOC2 scope.
Miguel (Privacy): I'll handle the DPA/subprocessor bits. Quick note: we don't include non-prod in SOC2 scope. I can pull the exact wording for the response.
Elena (Solutions): CardWave also asked if we support BYOK for keys. We can offer BYOK for Private and Dedicated, but Hosted uses Redwood-managed KMS. Happy to draft the language.
Sam (Eng): For embeddings retention they want shorter retention (90d) than our default. Technically we can set a TTL on the embeddings index per-tenant. Default is 365 days.
Leah (CS): Perfect — if we can offer 90d as an opt-in that should de-risk them. Can you provide a small config snippet to include in our reply?
Sam (Eng): Sure. Snippet for them: ```embeddings_retention_days: 90
storage_policy: tenant-ttl```
Miguel (Privacy): SOC2 wording I recommend: "Production systems and associated customer data stores are in-scope for our SOC2; development and staging environments are explicitly excluded from scope." I'll paste the exact excerpt in a sec.
Miguel (Privacy): Excerpt: "Scope: The assessment covers Redwood Inference production control plane and production-hosted data processing environments. Non-production environments (development, staging, test) are excluded from this report." Use that verbatim.
Elena (Solutions): On BYOK: I'll say: "BYOK available for Dedicated/Private deployments. For Hosted customers, keys are managed by Redwood KMS; we can discuss Dedicated options or a Private deployment if BYOK is required."
Leah (CS): Great. Can we also confirm subprocessors list? They flagged a few (GCS for storage, Sentry for errors). Miguel?
Miguel (Privacy): Current subprocessors: Google Cloud Storage, Datadog, Sentry, Fastly, and a managed DB provider. I can attach the subprocessors appendix file.
Leah (CS): Awesome — if you can upload the appendix to the ticket I'll reference it in the reply.
deploy-bot: Document uploaded to /shared/customer_evidence/CardWave/vendor_questionnaire.pdf (uploader: Miguel).
Sam (Eng): One more technical note: backups for staging are snapshot-only and not part of retention policies tied to production. We can confirm backups are not used for production restores. Short line to include: "Staging backups are snapshot-only for debugging and not included in production restore processes."
Elena (Solutions): Draft reply outline: 1) SOC2 scope excerpt (Miguel) 2) Subprocessors appendix (Miguel attach) 3) BYOK / deployment options (Elena) 4) Embeddings retention opt-in (Sam + snippet) 5) Next steps & timeline (Leah)
Leah (CS): I'm going to draft the email after we get the attachments and snippet. Assigning owners: @Miguel attach SOC2 + subprocessors, @Sam provide the snippet (done), @Elena write BYOK blurb. I'll do the final send. Target: reply out by EOD Wed. :thumbsup:
Sam (Eng): Confirmed — I will also CC eng-privacy for any follow-ups.
Miguel (Privacy): Uploaded SOC2 excerpt and subprocessors appendix to the ticket.
Leah (CS): Thanks all. If anything changes ping me here.
Elena (Solutions): Draft ready, leaving minor wording for Leah to finalize.
Leah (CS): Sending in 30m after quick pass. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
